title: A sealed call or answer between machines of one estate (fabric-agent-call/1, DEC-0106)
description: The payload member of a fabric-relay-message/1 body. HPKE (RFC 9180) base mode, suite [16, 1, 1], to the recipient's #kem key; info the ASCII bytes fabric-agent-call/1; additional data the RFC 8785 bytes of {type, kind, from, to, msgId, kem}, from, to and msgId being the enclosing body's signed members. The plaintext is the RFC 8785 bytes, at most 393216, of an agent-call-message document of the same kind. The relay reads none of it.

enc.description: The encapsulated key: an uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes), base64url.

ct.description: Ciphertext and tag, base64url: at most 393216 + 16 bytes.
